Based on the provided documents, lithium hydroxide is referenced regarding the Apollo 13 mission as follows: 

* Lithium hydroxide (LiOH) cartridges in the Lunar Module (LM) remove water and carbon dioxide from the cabin atmosphere. 
* For Apollo 13, LM LiOH availability was 53 hours, Command Module (CM) availability was 182 hours, and required duration was 85 hours.

ground_truth: In Apollo 11, lithium hydroxide filters in the environmental control system were used during cabin cleanup to capture abrasive airborne lunar dust after surface EVAs.
